title: Q4 board meeting prep
body:
Hi,

The Q4 board meeting is on November 12. I need the following by November 5:

1. Revenue and shipment-volume numbers for Q3
2. Updated hiring plan (Senior Data Engineer role)
3. Product roadmap slide

Please drop drafts into the shared Notion page "Q4 2026 OKRs".

Thanks,
